comment: Judgment calls for the HTML document that no vendored source makes. Every attribute entry has a reason. Entries with "pending": "whatwg-index" restate what the WHATWG attribute index (data/whatwg/indices.html) says and become redundant once that snapshot is vendored; the rest are deliberate choices. void/no_text stand in for the index's Children column until then.

accesskey.reason: Kept as a single key (as in the legacy document) for API ergonomics; the spec allows a space-separated list of single code points.

aria.reason: aria-* attributes (ARIA in HTML) are not in browser-compat-data's HTML globals; modelled as a prefix like data-*.

role.reason: ARIA role attribute (wai-aria IDL reflects it) is not in browser-compat-data's HTML globals.

class.reason: Set of space-separated tokens; DOM's Element.className is not reflected with a DOMTokenList type in IDL.

part.reason: CSS Shadow Parts: space-separated part names.

itemid.reason: Microdata globals are not listed by browser-compat-data; valid URL potentially surrounded by spaces.

itemprop.reason: Microdata; unordered set of unique space-separated tokens.

itemref.reason: Microdata; unordered set of unique space-separated tokens (IDs).

itemtype.reason: Microdata; unordered set of unique space-separated tokens (absolute URLs).

autocapitalize.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL only has a DOMString setter.

autocorrect.reason: Enumerated attribute (empty string = on); IDL exposes a boolean.

contenteditable.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL exposes a DOMString with custom getter.

draggable.reason: Enumerated true/false attribute, not a boolean attribute, although the IDL type is boolean.

hidden.reason: Enumerated attribute; the bare attribute means hidden. IDL type is a union.

popover.reason: Enumerated attribute (bare = auto). The legacy document typed it as String.

spellcheck.reason: Enumerated true/false attribute; IDL exposes a boolean.

translate.reason: Enumerated yes/no attribute; IDL exposes a boolean.

writingsuggestions.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL only has a DOMString setter.

crossorigin.reason: CORS settings attribute; IDL exposes a nullable DOMString.

decoding.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

fetchpriority.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

loading.reason: Lazy loading attribute, applies wherever the element has it (img, iframe, and video/audio in current HTML).

referrerpolicy.reason: Referrer Policy tokens. The WHATWG index only says "Referrer policy", so this stays a judgment call; the legacy document typed it as String.

popovertargetaction.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

formmethod.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

formenctype.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values; the legacy document typed it as String.

ping.reason: Set of space-separated valid non-empty URLs; IDL type is a plain USVString.

autocomplete.reason: Autofill detail tokens ("shipping street-address"), typed consistently on input/select/textarea; the legacy document mixed SST and String. form overrides this with on/off.

headers.reason: Set of space-separated element IDs; IDL type is a plain DOMString.

height.reason: Valid non-negative integer; embed/iframe/object reflect it as DOMString in IDL.

width.reason: Valid non-negative integer; embed/iframe/object reflect it as DOMString in IDL.

download.reason: Bare attribute (download) or a suggested file name: generated as an Enum with only the empty value plus custom values. The legacy document typed it as Bool, which cannot express a file name.

type.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL only has a DOMString setter.

command.reason: Built-in commands plus custom commands ("--name"), which the WHATWG index cannot express as a closed list.

closedby.reason: Enumerated attribute; IDL only has a DOMString setter.

autocomplete.reason: On a form the attribute is on/off only.

enctype.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

method.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

list.reason: ID of a datalist; IDL exposes a read-only element reference and browser-compat-data does not list it.

capture.reason: HTML Media Capture (W3C) facing mode; not in the HTML standard.

webkitdirectory.reason: Boolean attribute from the File and Directory Entries API; browser-compat-data lists it as standard-track.

type.reason: Keywords 1, a, A, i, I differ only in case, so an Enum would generate colliding Go identifiers (OlTypeA twice); kept as Char like the legacy document.

async.reason: Boolean attribute; the IDL attribute has a custom getter so it is not marked [Reflect].

wrap.reason: Enumerated attribute (IDL reflects it as DOMString).

scope.reason: Enumerated attribute; the legacy document typed it as String.

kind.reason: Enumerated attribute limited to known values.

http-equiv.reason: Pragma directives; IDL reflects a DOMString.

controlslist.reason: Set of tokens (nodownload, nofullscreen, noremoteplayback) from a WICG proposal that browser-compat-data lists as standard-track.

disableremoteplayback.reason: Boolean attribute from the Remote Playback API (W3C).
